support.title: Have a question? We're here to help

description.one: If you have questions or want to learn more about my classes, reach out in any way that is convenient for you.

1.question: Is Frame Up suitable if I have never danced before?
1.answer: Yes, this style is beginner-friendly. No dance experience is needed for the beginner group in Warsaw: it starts December 4, with classes on Fridays 18:00–19:00 in Wola. You can find the details and registration form on the Offline page. You can also start with the online beginner course “First Touch”. The main thing is your willingness to try and enjoy the process.

2.question: What should I bring to class?
2.answer: Wear comfortable clothes that let you move freely, and bring socks, knee pads, a bottle of water, and platform heels (strips), if you have them.

3.question: Can I join in the middle of a month or course?
3.answer: If you'd like to join mid-month, message me directly and I'll let you know when it's best to start, so you begin with new material. You'll find links to my Instagram and Telegram in the “Contact” section.

4.question: Is Frame Up right for me if I feel shy or afraid to move?
4.answer: Frame Up helps you open up naturally. Classes are held in a safe atmosphere where everyone feels support and respect. Shyness usually fades after the first sessions.

5.question: What is the difference between offline and online classes?
5.answer: Offline gives you group energy, live emotions and personal corrections. Online gives flexibility, comfort at home and learning at your own pace. Both formats bring real results.

6.question: What skill levels are available?
6.answer: In Warsaw, there is a beginner group to learn from scratch: it starts December 4, with classes on Fridays 18:00–19:00. Impro Room sessions offer improvisation practice. Private lessons are suitable for any level. Online, beginners can start with the First Touch course. The online group and choreography video tutorials are designed for intermediate dancers and above.

7.question: Can I train if my movement isn't fluid yet?
7.answer: Fluidity is a skill you can develop. Frame Up gently helps you open up your body, improve mobility and feel more at ease in your body.

8.question: Is Frame Up suitable for any age?
8.answer: Absolutely. Frame Up is about sensuality, confidence and the joy of movement, not age limits.

1.title: Lesson 1: Footwork fundamentals
1.description: We start with the basics of foot placement, both in heels and without heels. You learn to feel support, distribute body weight and stay stable in every movement. This is the foundation of body flow and expression.

2.title: Lesson 2: Living body — waves and spine
2.description: We open the body to flow. You explore soft waves, spinal mobility and torso control. You learn to connect breath with movement so the dance feels alive, fluid and sensual.

3.title: Lesson 3: Legs — en l'air, swings, kicks
3.description: We develop leg strength and expression. You master core elements and learn to execute them technically, clearly and with character. We focus on lines, amplitude and control.

4.title: Lesson 4: Performance — gaze and emotion
4.description: Dance is not only technique, but also a story. You learn to work on your performance: gaze, facial expression and inner state — how to convey emotion, draw the viewer in, and feel confident and authentic on stage and in class.

5.title: Lesson 5: Putting it all into choreography
5.description: We combine everything you have learned into your first full choreography. You dance, feel and enjoy. This is the point where technique becomes art and movement becomes personal style.

bio.1: I am Anna Strok, a professional dancer and teacher with many years of teaching experience and a clear artistic style.
bio.2: I am the creator and organiser of Total Strip Weekend in Minsk, the largest Frame Up Strip and High Heels championship in Belarus, which gathered hundreds of dancers and became an important event for the dance community.

quote.1: Today I develop Frame Up in Poland: I lead groups where people open up through movement, and I continue to learn from European masters to grow together with my students.
quote.2: My goal is to strengthen Frame Up culture and inspire people to be bold, free and expressive by creating a space where everyone can feel their strength, beauty and creative energy.

1.text: A new pre-recorded lesson is uploaded to the chat every week. You can work with it at any convenient time during the week.

2.title: New lessons in every cycle
2.text: Each cycle covers new topics: technique, foundations, routines, improvisation, acrobatics and choreography, with 5 lessons on different themes.

3.title: Homework with feedback
3.text: You practise, complete assignments, send videos and receive my comments, corrections and recommendations for growth.

statement.text: Your space for inspiration, practice and growth in dance.
statement.caption: Inspiration HUB

1.title: Payment and joining
1.description: Right after payment, your personal link to the library appears on the page and in your email — the library is on Telegram. Open it from the Telegram account you will use: the link works once and only for you.

2.title: Access period
2.description: It counts from payment, not from joining the library: pay on 1 March and you have access until 26 April. The exact dates are on the “My access” page; every email has a button to it.

3.title: Renewal at a special price
3.description: There are no automatic charges. You can renew any time while your access is open — the new period starts right after the current one, so no day is lost. 7 and 3 days before the end you get an email with a “Renew” button; the same one is on the “My access” page.

4.title: After the Online Group
4.description: Haven’t finished all the lessons of your cycle? When it ends, you don’t have to move on to a new one: choose Inspiration HUB alone and catch up at your own pace — it holds the lessons of all past cycles, including your current one. You get it at a special price with either plan; we post the link in the group chat.

5.title: If you do not renew
5.description: At the end of the period, library access closes by itself. You can come back at any time, but at the regular price — the new period counts from payment.

PrivacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy (GDPR)
PrivacyPolicyPage.description:
The controller of your personal data is Hanna Karzhova.
ul. Jana Kazimierza 64A/660, 01-248 Warsaw
Tax ID (NIP): 5273113119
E-mail: kroxxxxx92@gmail.com
PrivacyPolicyPage.contactLine: For matters related to personal data processing, please contact: kroxxxxx92@gmail.com

1.title: 1. Purposes of processing

2.title: 2. Legal basis for processing

3.title: 3. Scope of collected data
3.text:
Collected data may include: first and last name, phone number, email address, usernames on social media platforms, as well as data necessary to process orders and communicate.
In the case of purchasing an online course, additional data may be processed: order-related data (course name, purchase date, payment status), technical and usage data (IP address, system logs), and — if applicable — data required for accounting documents (VAT ID / invoicing details).
As a rule, payment data is processed by the payment provider — the controller may only receive information about the payment status.
If you consent to analytics, pseudonymous usage data is additionally processed: a random identifier stored in your browser, information about your device, browser, operating system, screen size and language, approximate location (country/city) determined from the IP address, the domain of the referring website and campaign (UTM) parameters, pages viewed and interactions on the website (e.g., clicks, scroll depth, use of the checkout form — without the data you enter), page performance measurements, and session recordings in which all text and form fields are masked. On the checkout and payment result pages only the page path and purchase-step events with public product data (product, price, currency) are collected, and no session recordings are made there. Analytics data is not linked to your name, email address, or order details.

4.title: 4. Data recipients / processors
4.text:
Data may be transferred to entities supporting the controller in providing services, in particular:
- payment system providers (Stripe),
- hosting / course delivery platform (Telegram) / tools used to provide access to materials,
- website and product analytics provider with EU data residency (Mixpanel),
- email, communication, and customer support tools (Gmail, Telegram),
- accounting services (if applicable),
- IT support.
Data is not sold or shared with third parties for their own marketing purposes. It may also be disclosed to public authorities only where required by law.

5.title: 5. Transfers of data outside the EEA
5.text: If you use providers based outside the European Economic Area (e.g., certain cloud services), personal data may be transferred outside the EEA only in accordance with the GDPR (e.g., based on Standard Contractual Clauses) and with appropriate safeguards in place.

6.title: 6. Data retention

7.title: 7. Rights of the data subject
7.text:
You have the right to access your data, rectify it, erase it, restrict processing, object to processing, data portability, and to lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (PUODO).
Where processing is based on consent, you have the right to withdraw your consent at any time.

8.title: 8. Voluntary provision of data
8.text: Providing personal data is voluntary; however, it is necessary to participate in classes or events and to process an order for the online course and provide access to digital content.

9.title: 9. Automated decision-making / profiling
9.text: We do not make automated decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects. With your analytics consent, pseudonymous usage events may be segmented to understand how groups of visitors use the website; these segments are used only to improve the website, content, and purchase flow.

CookiePolicyPage.title: Cookie Policy
CookiePolicyPage.description: This page explains which cookies and similar storage technologies are used on the website, for what purposes, and how you can manage your consent choices.
CookiePolicyPage.contactLine: For questions about cookies and consent settings, please contact us: kroxxxxx92@gmail.com

1.title: 1. What cookies and similar technologies are
1.text: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser. Similar technologies include, among others, sessionStorage/localStorage and other mechanisms used to store data on your device.

2.title: 2. Categories we use
2.text:
The website uses the following storage technologies:
a) Necessary (always active):
- `NEXT_LOCALE` cookie (our website) to remember the selected interface language, up to 12 months;
- `cookie-consent:v2` in localStorage (our website) to store your cookie choice, kept until you change the choice or clear browser data;
- technical Stripe cookies (for example `__stripe_mid`, `__stripe_sid`) when the payment form is used.
- the Telegram login script (telegram.org) is loaded only on the checkout page when you confirm your Telegram account; during that authorization Telegram may use its own cookies on its domain.
b) Functional (consent-based):
- `payment-checkout-draft:v2` in sessionStorage for checkout draft recovery, kept until the tab is closed or storage is cleared.
c) Analytics (consent-based):
- Mixpanel stores a pseudonymous browser identifier and consent marker in localStorage and may temporarily use IndexedDB for session replay. It measures page views, traffic source, device/browser, approximate location, scroll and selected product interactions. Session recordings mask all text and form inputs and are disabled on admin and payment pages. Analytics is processed using Mixpanel's EU data residency.
- `analytics-event:*` entries in sessionStorage (our website) — short markers so the same event is not counted twice in one visit; kept until the tab is closed.

3.title: 3. Legal basis
3.text: Necessary technologies are used under the exemption where they are required to provide a service explicitly requested by the user. Functional and analytics technologies are used only after obtaining your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

4.title: 4. Storage period

5.title: 5. How to change or withdraw consent
5.text: At any time, you can open “Cookie settings” in the website footer and change your selection. Consent withdrawal applies going forward and does not affect the lawfulness of processing performed before withdrawal.

6.title: 6. Additional information
6.text: Detailed information about personal data processing, your rights, and controller details is available in the Privacy Policy.
